title: वेज बिरयानी बनाने का ये तरीका देख के कहेंगे की पहले क्यों नहीं पता था | Soya Veg Biryani
description:
#biryani #veg #soya #nutri 

SOYA BIRYANI 

INGREDIENTS TO MAKE THE RECIPE:

1 Cup Soya 
1 Carrot 
2 Onion (for Birsta)
25 Gms Beans 
2 Potatoes 
1/2 Capsicum 
5 Green Chillies 
50 Gms Mint Leaves 
100 Gms Coriander Leaves 

FOR MARINATION 

1/3 Cup Curd 
1 Tbsp Ginger Garlic Paste 
1/2 tsp Haldi  Powder 
1 tsp Red Chilli Powder 
1 tsp Biryani Masala 
1 tsp Kasuri Methi 
1 tsp Achar Masala 
1 tsp Salt 
2 Cups Basmati Rice 
Mint and Coriander Leaves (as Needed)


1/2 Cup Warm Milk + KESAR




FOR BOILING RICE 
1 Liter Water 
1 Tbsp Salt 
1 Tej Patta
3 Choti Elachi 
4 - 5 Black Peppercorns 
2 - 3 Cloves 
1/2 Lemon 
Mint and Coriander Leaves (as Needed)
1/2 tsp Biryani Masala 
2 Green Chillies 
Oil 

FOR FINAL DUM 

OIL AS NEEDED
1 tsp Jeera 
4 Choti Elachi 
4 - 5 Cloves 
6 Black Peppercorns 
1 Dal Chini

FINAL TADKA 

1 Tbsp Desi Ghee 
1 tsp Biryani Masala 
1 tsp Kewra Water 
Red Food Color (If Needed)
